FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.title: Holy Emblem
FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.description: Choose an initial factor for each slot. After drawing each turn, add one Mana to your Draw Pile and one to your Discard Pile. View factors and use tools in the Magic Book.
